'''Jonny Chu''' is a long-standing member of [[Team Albany]] and later [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. He finished '''#2''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: ROps; Light: TRM).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026)</ref>

[[File:Jonny Chu DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Chu at [[DecipherCon 2000]] after [[Team Albany]] won the Star Wars CCG team championship]]

At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he won Sunday's four-player team championship with [[Matt Sokol]], [[Chris Terwilliger]], and [[Brian Terwilliger]].<ref name="eltwigg">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Brian Terwilliger], X (14 November 2020)</ref>
